en-US.description: Offline, GPU-accelerated local voice-to-text dictation for Windows
en-US.longDescription: Verbtm provides real-time, private, offline speech-to-text dictation directly into any active Windows application using local Whisper models with CUDA GPU and CPU acceleration. No cloud telemetry, no subscription fees, and no clipboard overwrites.
